evidence: Static review; no container was run. task/tests/test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template test.sh (diff empty), as are tests/Dockerfile, environment/Dockerfile and tools/restart_mcp.py. Each launch assumption maps to a public statement: (1) entry file /app/server.js required at test.sh:68 and launched with node at :111 -> integration.md:3 'We start it with node /app/server.js', instruction.md:5 'Put the app in /app'. (2) Symlink refusal test.sh:72-83 -> integration.md:11 states the identical rule. (3) PORT=3000 at test.sh:108 and probes on 127.0.0.1:3000 at :48 -> integration.md:3 'Listen on 0.0.0.0:3000'. (4) Liveness probe /api/health then / at test.sh:48, any HTTP status accepted (:51-52) -> integration.md:3 'serve the workspace at / and answer GET /api/health promptly'; no response body shape is assumed, and the only criterion touching health (functional judge.toml:308) just loads it in a tab. (5) DB_PATH=/app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db at test.sh:98-101,109 -> integration.md:9 default path /app/app.db, DB_PATH absolute override 'including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app'. (6) Launch from the /tmp/submission copy and cwd /tests (tests/Dockerfile:45) -> integration.md:3 'working directory that may be outside /app. Resolve files from their actual location'. (7) NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules at test.sh:106 with express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 in tests/Dockerfile:20-21, same pins as environment/Dockerfile:10-11 -> integration.md:5 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH ... Include everything needed at runtime; opening the finished app must not require an install or build step'. (8) Restart helper test.sh:127-193 kills the process group and relaunches on the same DB_PATH -> integration.md:7,9 and behaviour.md:9 'survive a complete server restart'. (9) Seed: test.sh performs no seeding and only chmods /assets (:88); instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 name /assets/seed_data.json; task.toml:2 carries /assets as an artifact. (10) No fixed clock, account or same-origin assumption exists in test.sh; app_context.md:10 says no sign-in, matching instruction.md:5. Weak-app probe: an app ignoring DB_PATH or resolving files from cwd is told not to, so its failure is fair. Conforming-alternative probe: an app following integration.md (own static files via __dirname, bundled extra deps under /app/node_modules, SQLite at DB_PATH) launches under env -i as uid 65534 because test.sh:87 chowns /app or falls back to the writable copy. Residual observations, not defects of this row: uid 65534, HOME=/tmp/submission and the SIGTERM-based stop are not stated publicly, but a contract-following app does not depend on them and this matches the template note; the agent image has the sqlite3 CLI and git (environment/Dockerfile:6) while the verifier image does not, which integration.md:5 covers by listing what the launch image supplies. The golden's start under the exact test.sh launch path (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH) is unmeasured per raw-evidence-index.json limitations; that belongs to row 19 and the pipeline's verifier-launch runtime record, and server.js:7-8,12,142 reads DB_PATH, __dirname and 0.0.0.0:3000 as stated.
